tender_overview.title: Development of Distribution Infrastructure & System Strengthening works at Nagpur Zone of MSEDCL, Maharashtra under Power Distribution Enhancement Program funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB)
tender_overview.issuing_authority: Chief Engineer (Spl. Projects), Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL)
tender_overview.bid_system: Single Stage Two-Envelope Bidding Process with e-Procurement

eligibility_and_qualification.contractor_class_required: Electrical Contractor License required - must possess license for execution of works or equivalent license from any State in India

technical.heading_note: For the purpose of this bid, bidder shall meet minimum criteria in past 7 years up to 31/03/2026
technical.similar_works_definition: Construction works in electrical power sector including: 1) EHT lines 2) HT lines 3) LT lines 4) Distribution transformers 5) Substations. Experience in only LT lines would not be considered eligible

options.requirement: Experience in similar work under single contract, costing not less than 70% of the tender cost excluding GST (completed works only)
Experience in similar works under two contracts, each costing not less than 40% of the tender cost excluding GST (completed works only)
Experience in similar works under three contracts, each costing not less than 30% of the tender cost excluding GST (completed works only)

financial.requirement: Net Worth must be positive for each of the last three Financial Years. Net worth = paid-up capital + free reserves (excluding revaluation reserves) - accumulated losses - intangible assets
MAAT for best three years out of last five financial years should not be less than 30% of estimated tender cost
Must have liquid assets and/or evidence of access to fund based credit facilities of not less than 10% of estimated tender cost. Credit facility must be earmarked for the Works on receipt of Bid

All JV partners must meet Net Worth requirement individually. JV must collectively meet MAAT and Liquid Assets requirements. At least one partner must meet 40% of minimum criteria, others must meet 25%
All pending litigations shall in total not be more than fifty percent (50%) of the bidder's net worth

financial_terms.delayed_interest_rate: MCLR for one year of State Bank of India

conditions: Initial interest bearing adjustable Advance of 15% of Contract Price for Contract Part I
Initial interest bearing adjustable Advance of 10% of Contract Price for Contract Part II

progressive_payments.milestone: Erection, testing and commissioning of works

firm_components: Charges for Erection, Inland Freight & Insurance
All other equipment/items except those specified under applicable materials
Advance payment portion (no price adjustment applicable on advance)
variable_components: Transmission Line Towers and Steel Structures
All materials published by IEEMA price variation formulas

materials.name: ACSR Conductor
materials.formula: P = Po + WA(AL – ALo) + WF(FE – FEo) [For Excise duty units] or P = Po + WA(ALe – ALoe) + WF(FEe – FEoe) [For Excise duty exempted units]

materials.name: Power Transformers
materials.formula: P = 0.01 X Po (6 + 32 X (C/Co) + 27 X (ES/ESo) + 12 X (IS/ISo) + 4 X (IM/IMo) + 9 X (TO/TOo) + 10 X (W/Wo))

materials.name: Distribution Transformers - Aluminum Wound
materials.formula: P = 0.01 X Po (8 + 22 X (AL/ALo) + 36 X(ES/ESo) + 12 X (IS/ISo) + 5 X (IM/IMo) + 10 X(TO/TOo) + 7 X (W/Wo))

materials.name: Distribution Transformers - Copper Wound
materials.formula: P = 0.01 X Po (7 + 41 X (C/Co) + 23 X(ES/ESo) + 10X (IS/ISo) + 5 X (IM/IMo) + 8 X(TO/TOo) + 6 X (W/Wo))

materials.name: Steel Transmission Line Towers
materials.formula: EC1= EC0 * [F + 0.18 * (HA1/HA0) + 0.40 * (LA1/LA0) + 0.16 * (Zn1/Zn0) + 0.11 * (L1/L0)] [For both heavy and lighter angles]

materials.name: Steel Tubular Poles
materials.index_source: IEEMA price variation formula for poles

materials.name: Steel Polygonal Poles
materials.index_source: IEEMA price variation formula for poles

materials.name: Power Cables - Aluminum PVC 1.1kV
materials.formula: P=Po + AlF(AL – Alo) + CCFAl(PVCC – PVCco) + FeF(Fe – Feo)

materials.name: Power Cables - Copper PVC 1.1kV
materials.formula: P = Po + CuF(Cu – Cuo) + CCFCu(PVCC – PVCco) + FeF(Fe – Feo)

materials.name: HV Aerial Bunched Cables - Aluminum
materials.formula: P = P0 + Alph *n *(Al-Al0) + Alm(Al-Al0) + CUFtph * n *(Cu-Cu0) + CCF1Alph * n* (CC-CC0) + CCF2Alph * n *(PVCc-PVCc0) + CCFAlm (CC-CC0)

special_requirements: Performance Security valid till 180 days beyond Defect Liability Period
Quality control by Third Party Quality Monitoring Agency (TPQMA)
Contractor liable for defects found by Electrical Inspector at no extra cost
Volume and quality of concreting must meet specifications - contractor to redo at own cost if defective
All metallic structures must be galvanized - replacement required if rusted
Painting of metallic supports as per specifications - re-painting required if rusted
Employer reserves right to withhold payment for defective works
Quantity variation limit: +/-50% for individual items

grouped_documents: Conformity Undertaking on Compliance of bidding documents
Legal status documents (Certificate of Incorporation/Partnership deed etc.)
Declaration of conformance to eligibility requirements
Joint Venture documents (if applicable): Power of Attorney, Joint Deed of Undertaking, Joint Venture Agreement
Qualification Requirements data and documentary evidence
Details of major Plant and Installation Services to be subcontracted
Option for Interest bearing Initial Advance payment and E-payment information
Certificate from banker indicating fund-based limits
